EmailTemplate.subject: {Last Chance} Join Flywire and Elevate at HFMA Western Symposium!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {{lead.First Name:default=}},
If you don't already have plans for your first night at this year's HFMA Western Symposium, we'd love to help kickoff the event with you.
Our team would like to invite you to join Flywire and Elevate at Alexxa's in the Paris Hotel on Sunday, January 22nd from 6:00pm - 8:00pm for a happy hour reception and an evening of networking and reconnecting!
Haven't registered yet? Click here <[[https://elevatepfs.com/hfma-wrs/?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> so we can make sure to save your spot at Alexxa's!
We've extended our deadline to signup for this event until Friday, January 13th at Midnight EST. Hope to see you there.
Thanks,
The Flywire Team
